title: Table 37. Low-power mode wakeup timings
text_helper: Table 37. Low-power mode wakeup timings — section 6.3.8 Wakeup time from low-power modes. Symbol, Parameter, Conditions, Typ(1), Max(1), +1 autres.

rows: Wakeup from Stop mode with MR/LP regulator in normal mode
Main regulator is ON and Flash memory in Deep power down mode
Wakeup from Stop mode with MR/LP regulator in normal mode
Low power regulator is ON and Flash memory in Deep power down mode
Wakeup from Stop mode with MR/LP regulator in Under-drive mode
Main regulator in under-drive mode (Flash memory in Deep power-down mode)
Wakeup from Stop mode with MR/LP regulator in Under-drive mode
Low power regulator in under-drive mode (Flash memory in Deep power-down mode)
Exit Standby mode on rising edge
Exit Standby mode on falling edge
notes: 2. The wakeup times are measured from the wakeup event to the point in which the application code reads the first
